title: Goddaughter Forged My Stake, Sold My Kimonos, Sent Me A $4,100 Check. So I Had Her Hem Her Lies.
description: When my goddaughter forged our partnership dissolution and sold my restored vintage kimono collection for $690K, she thought a $4,100 check for a serger would silence me. I found the original notarized agreement hidden in a 1920s kimono lining, voided the sale, and now she hand-rolls hems at Silk of Deceit Studio with her federal fraud docket on every scarf. #RevengeStory #Betrayal #Karma
thumb_text: HER FRAUD DOCKET NUMBER ON EVERY SCARF
pinned_comment: If my goddaughter forged my stake and sent me a $4,100 serger check, I would have dug through that dumpster without a second thought. What would you do if you found the original notarized agreement sewn inside a kimono lining? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: BUT I FOUND THE ONE THING SHE NEVER DESTROYED
